UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated NexaEarn player wallet, daily level quota, and streak state.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

displayName.description: Display name shown in the wallet header.

email.description: Optional user email from Google Sign-In.

dailyGamesPlayed.description: Number of Tic Tac Toe levels played on lastPlayedDate (unlimited per day).

lastPlayedDate.description: Local date string (yyyy-MM-dd) of last match.

currentStreak.description: Consecutive days of daily streak ad claims.

lastStreakClaimDate.description: Local date string (yyyy-MM-dd) of last daily streak ad claim.

bonusAdCycleProgress.description: Completed ads toward the 3-ad Watch Ads bundle (0..2); resets to 0 on the 3rd ad when +15 coins are awarded.

totalGamesWon.description: Total Tic Tac Toe matches won.

totalGamesPlayed.description: Total Tic Tac Toe matches completed.

referralCode.description: Unique uppercase referral code owned by this user.

referredByUid.description: Optional UID of the friend who referred this user.

referredByCode.description: Optional referral code applied by this user.

referralBonusEarned.description: Total bonus coins earned from completed friend referrals.

referralsCompletedCount.description: Number of invited friends who completed their first 5 games.

lastClaimedReferralUid.description: Most recent invitee UID whose referral bonus was claimed.

goalWindowStartMillis.description: Epoch millis when the current 24-hour 100-coin goal window started.

goalWindowCoins.description: Coins earned from Daily Streak, mini games, and Watch Ads in the current 24-hour window.

extraEarnPotHundredths.description: Accumulated 5% Extra Earn pot stored in 1/100th coin units (100 = 1 coin).

totalExtraEarnClaimed.description: Lifetime Extra Earn coins claimed into the main wallet balance.

banned.description: Whether the user has been banned/blacklisted by an Admin.

whitelisted.description: Whether the user has been explicitly whitelisted as a trusted account by an Admin.

banReason.description: Optional reason shown when a user is banned/blacklisted.

bannedByEmail.description: Optional admin email that applied the ban.

bannedAt.description: Server timestamp when user was banned/blacklisted.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on update.

GameMatch.title: GameMatch
GameMatch.description: Completed mini-game round record (Tic Tac Toe, Tap Tap, or Math Quiz) and post-match ad status.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

coinsAwarded.description: Coins credited for this round (5 for Tic Tac Toe/Tap Tap, 10 for Math Quiz after watching rewarded ad, 0 if skipped).

adWatched.description: Whether the required post-match rewarded ad was completed.

adSource.description: Source of the rewarded ad served.

RewardEvent.title: RewardEvent
RewardEvent.description: Immutable ledger entry for coins earned via rewarded ads, daily streaks, matches, and referrals.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

adSource.description: Rewarded ad, referral, Extra Earn pot, or Admin source.

note.description: Human-readable description of the reward event.

WithdrawalRequest.title: WithdrawalRequest
WithdrawalRequest.description: User coin withdrawal request to eSewa Wallet, Bank Account, or SIM Card Recharge.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

accountTitle.description: Account holder name, bank name, or mobile carrier.

destination.description: eSewa ID, bank account number, or mobile phone number.

coins.description: Coins deducted for this withdrawal request.

status.description: Withdrawal status managed from PENDING -> COMPLETED or FAILED by Admin.

processedByEmail.description: Optional admin email that reviewed the request.

processedAt.description: Server timestamp when Admin processed the request.

ReferralCodeEntry.title: ReferralCodeEntry
ReferralCodeEntry.description: Publicly resolvable referral code lookup mapping a user's invite code to their UID and display name.

ReferralRecord.title: ReferralRecord
ReferralRecord.description: Tracks an invited friend's first 5 games and bonus payout status for the referrer.

AppConfig.title: AppConfig
AppConfig.description: Live remote configuration updated from Admin Panel (WhatsApp support, Terms & Conditions, announcements, maintenance mode).

rewardedAdUnitId.description: Active Google AdMob Rewarded Ad Unit ID (empty when removed/disabled).

bannerAdUnitId.description: Active Google AdMob Banner Ad Unit ID (empty when removed/disabled).

savedRewardedAdUnitIds.description: Saved pool of Google AdMob Rewarded Ad Unit IDs managed by Admin.

savedBannerAdUnitIds.description: Saved pool of Google AdMob Banner Ad Unit IDs managed by Admin.

AdminNotification.title: AdminNotification
AdminNotification.description: Live custom push notification sent by Admin to all users or a specific user.

AdminSession.title: AdminSession
AdminSession.description: Admin authorization record unlocked via SHA-256 verified admin key.

/users/{userId}.description: User wallet profile, daily level count, streak state, and referral counters.

/users/{userId}/matches/{matchId}.description: User's Tic Tac Toe match history and post-match rewarded ad completion state.

/users/{userId}/rewards/{rewardId}.description: User's immutable coin reward history ledger.

/referralCodes/{code}.description: Referral code lookup table keyed by uppercase invite code.

/referrals/{inviteeUid}.description: Per-invitee referral milestone record tracking progress toward first 5 games.

/notifications/{notificationId}.description: Live custom push notifications sent from Admin Panel to all or specific users.

/admins/{userId}.description: Admin session document protected by hash verification in Firestore Rules.
